property.name: scholarchain.output.replaceIncomplete
property.description: When an output directory for the same run ID exists without a completion record, fail (false) or replace it (true). A complete output (_SUCCESS plus _job.json) is always reused, which makes reruns idempotent. Operational (not fingerprinted): rerunning a failed run with this set to true keeps the run ID and replaces that run's incomplete directory.

property.name: scholarchain.intermediate.compress
property.description: Compress map outputs (shuffle data) between map and reduce. Operational (not fingerprinted): job outputs do not depend on it.

property.name: scholarchain.intermediate.codec
property.description: Codec for intermediate (map output) compression. DefaultCodec (zlib) has a pure Java fallback, so it works without native libraries. Operational (not fingerprinted).

property.name: scholarchain.output.compress
property.description: Compress final job outputs. Off by default so curated JSON lines stay inspectable; turn on for full-scale EMR runs.

property.name: scholarchain.output.codec
property.description: Codec for final outputs when scholarchain.output.compress is true.

property.name: scholarchain.reject.previewChars
property.description: Maximum characters of the offending input copied into a reject record. The full input is identified by its sha256 and location instead. The input formats keep 4 bytes per configured character of an oversize or truncated unit (enough for UTF-8), so larger values are honoured, never capped; a value whose byte size exceeds the largest Java array fails the job at configuration time.

property.name: scholarchain.input.maxDecompressedBytesPerFile
property.description: Decompression-bomb guard: maximum bytes read from one input file after decompression (8 GiB; the full dblp release is estimated at 5.49 GB). Exceeding it stops the file and writes a decompression_limit_exceeded reject.

property.name: scholarchain.internal.maxLineBytes
property.description: Maximum bytes of one JSON line produced by an upstream ScholarChain job (64 MiB; a 5,000-author team is about 0.2 MiB).

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.parsePolicyVersion
property.description: Parse policy version written to provenance.policyVersion of J01, J07, J08.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.boundaryElements
property.description: Every dblp record element (dblp.dtd). The XML input format splits the file only at these start tags, so each is read and accounted for, selected or not.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.recordElements
property.description: Record elements extracted into WorkRecord (dblp-subset-v1 record_elements). Other boundary elements are written to excluded/ with reason element.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.subset.enabled
property.description: Apply the key-prefix, year and publtype rules below (dblp-subset-v1, status proposed in datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml).

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.subset.keyPrefixes
property.description: dblp key prefixes in the subset (dataset manifest subset_rule.dblp.venues).

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.subset.yearMin
property.description: Inclusive lower year bound of the subset.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.subset.yearMax
property.description: Inclusive upper year bound of the subset.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.subset.excludePubltypeTokens
property.description: Records whose publtype contains one of these tokens are excluded.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.supportedEncodings
property.description: Declared XML encodings accepted. All are ASCII-compatible, which the byte-level record splitter requires; other encodings reject every record of the file.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.maxRecordBytes
property.description: Maximum bytes of one dblp record. Larger records are skipped to their end tag and rejected as oversize_record.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.maxPrologBytes
property.description: Maximum bytes read from the start of a dblp file to find the XML declaration and the internal DTD subset, and maximum size of an external DTD file.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.dtdPath
property.description: Optional path of the dblp DTD (for the real release: dblp.dtd from the raw prefix). Its general entities are added to those of the file's internal DTD subset. Empty means internal subset only. An entity defined by neither rejects the record (undefined_entity).

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.maxExpandedRecordChars
property.description: Maximum length, in UTF-16 characters, of one dblp record after named-entity expansion (2 Mi characters, about 4 MiB of heap; twice scholarchain.dblp.maxRecordBytes). Expansion is single-pass, but a record can reference a large declared entity many times (a ~1 MiB entity referenced ~300,000 times would expand quadratically). The bound is checked before each replacement is appended, so such a record is rejected (expanded_record_oversize) without building the expansion. The sample entities expand to numeric character references of at most 6 characters (for example "é"), so records of the samples do not grow materially when expanded.

property.name: scholarchain.dblp.reducers
property.description: J01 reduce tasks (partitions of works, mentions and venues).

property.name: scholarchain.teams.oversizeThreshold
property.description: Teams with more authors are counted (OVERSIZE_AUTHOR_TEAMS) and listed in oversizeTeams/, and are still expanded.

property.name: scholarchain.teams.hardLimit
property.description: Teams with more authors are rejected (team_exceeds_hard_limit): no team and no pairs. 5,000 authors would expand to 12,497,500 pairs.

property.name: scholarchain.teams.maxCoauthorContext
property.description: Maximum coauthor names stored per mention context (blocking input); longer lists are cut and flagged coauthorsTruncated.

property.name: scholarchain.teams.reducers
property.description: J07 reduce tasks.

property.name: scholarchain.pairs.pairsPerShard
property.description: Pairs generated by one reduce call. A team of n authors is split into ceil(n(n-1)/2 / pairsPerShard) shards that are hashed to different reducers, so a giant team never expands on one machine.

property.name: scholarchain.pairs.expandReducers
property.description: J08a reduce tasks (pair expansion).

property.name: scholarchain.pairs.consolidateReducers
property.description: J08b reduce tasks (per-work duplicate consolidation).

property.name: scholarchain.normalize.policyVersion
property.description: Policy version of J02 outputs.

property.name: scholarchain.normalize.maxLineBytes
property.description: Maximum bytes of one raw JSON line (4 MiB; the largest sample line is about 9 KiB). Longer lines are rejected as oversize_line.

property.name: scholarchain.normalize.keepCrossrefAbstracts
property.description: Crossref abstracts may be under publisher copyright (dataset manifest); they are dropped unless this is true.

property.name: scholarchain.normalize.reducers
property.description: J02 reduce tasks.

property.name: scholarchain.idjoin.policyVersion
property.description: Policy version of ExternalIdLink records (exact canonical identifier equality only; no fuzzy matching).

property.name: scholarchain.idjoin.maxGroupSize
property.description: Maximum records sharing one identifier key. Larger groups are not joined; they are counted as OVERSIZE_BLOCKS and written to conflicts/.

property.name: scholarchain.idjoin.reducers
property.description: J04 reduce tasks.

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.keyFamilies
property.description: Primary blocking key families (comma-separated), keyed by the shared core rule AuthorNameKey (author-name-key/1): dblp-base-name (AuthorNameKey.baseNameKey: the dblp name without its homonym suffix, NFD) and initials-surname (AuthorNameKey.initialsSurnameKey: "J. Smith", "John Smith" and "Jane Smith" share "j smith"). The default keeps the Phase 4 family only; set dblp-base-name,initials-surname to add the initials family.

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.maxBlockSize
property.description: Member cap of J05 primary blocks. J05 treats a block as oversize when it has more members than this OR more pairs (m(m-1)/2) than scholarchain.candidates.maxPairsPerBlock; the effective cap is min(maxBlockSize, largest m whose pairs fit maxPairsPerBlock), 500 with the defaults. Oversize blocks are not emitted; they are counted as OVERSIZE_BLOCKS (those over the pair limit only also as PAIR_LIMIT_OVERSIZE_BLOCKS), listed in oversizeBlocks/ (key, size, limit = effective cap, maxBlockSize, maxPairsPerBlock, pairs, reason max_block_size or max_pairs_per_block), and their members are written to oversizeMembers/ for the fallback (J05b) and its coverage accounting (J05c). So every emitted block is expanded by J06, for any combination of the two settings.

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.fallback.families
property.description: Primary families whose oversize blocks are re-blocked by J05b. Members of oversize blocks of other families are counted (scholarchain.fallback-not-configured) and end up uncovered.

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.fallback.secondaryKeys
property.description: Secondary keys of the fallback (comma-separated; empty disables the fallback). Each kind k re-blocks an oversize block (family, key) into fallback family family.k keyed by the primary key plus: coauthor (each coauthor's AuthorNameKey.fullNameKey, so members that share a coauthor dblp name meet), venue (the dblp venue key), or coauthor-venue (each coauthor and venue combination).

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.fallback.maxBlockSize
property.description: Member cap of J05b fallback blocks. As in J05, a fallback block is oversize when it has more members than this OR more pairs than scholarchain.candidates.maxPairsPerBlock (effective cap min(fallback.maxBlockSize, largest m whose pairs fit)). Oversize fallback blocks are not emitted: they are counted as OVERSIZE_BLOCKS in J05b (over the pair limit only: also PAIR_LIMIT_OVERSIZE_BLOCKS) and listed in fallbackOversizeBlocks/ with the same limit fields as J05. Members of an oversize primary block that land in no emitted fallback block of two or more members are counted (FALLBACK_UNCOVERED_MEMBERS) and listed in J05c uncoveredMembers/; oversizeKeySummary/ gives covered and uncovered counts per oversize key (the worst keys have the most uncovered members). 500 members yield 124,750 pairs, within the default scholarchain.candidates.maxPairsPerBlock.

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.fallback.reducers
property.description: J05b and J05c reduce tasks.

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.emitSingletons
property.description: Emit blocks with one member (they yield no candidate pairs).

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.policyVersion
property.description: Policy version of candidate blocks (J05, J05b, J05c). Version 2: keys from the core AuthorNameKey rule (author-name-key/1), the initials-surname family and the oversize fallback. History: blocking/1-provisional (Phase 4, dblp-base-name only).

property.name: scholarchain.blocking.reducers
property.description: J05 reduce tasks.

property.name: scholarchain.candidates.featureSet
property.description: Feature set computed by J06 and written to provenance.policyVersion of every MatchCandidate (with the blocking policy of its block). Provisional: deterministic, policy-free comparisons only (no thresholds, scores or decisions); the feature policy is owned by entity-resolution-engineer (Phase 5). J06 fails at configuration time if this names a set it does not implement.

property.name: scholarchain.candidates.maxPairsPerBlock
property.description: Maximum candidate pairs from one block (a block of m members yields m(m-1)/2; 500 members yield 124,750). Also read by J05 and J05b, which treat blocks above this pair count as oversize (fallback, coverage accounting) and never emit them, so with one configuration J06 receives no block above the limit. A block above it that J06 still reads (blocks made under another configuration) is not expanded: it is counted as OVERSIZE_BLOCKS (its pairs as OVERSIZE_BLOCK_PAIRS_SKIPPED), listed in oversizeBlocks/, and each of its members is written to unexpandedMembers/ (uncovered-member records, UNEXPANDED_BLOCK_MEMBERS, per family in scholarchain.unexpanded-members-per-family).

property.name: scholarchain.candidates.pairsPerShard
property.description: Candidate pairs generated by one J06 reduce call. A block is split into ceil(m(m-1)/2 / pairsPerShard) shards hashed to different reducers.

property.name: scholarchain.candidates.reducers
property.description: J06 reduce tasks.

property.name: scholarchain.candidates.skipSameNumberedName
property.description: Optional volume rule (Phase 5 decision 6): when true, J06 emits no candidate for a pair whose two mentions carry the same homonym-numbered dblp name (for example two "Wei Wang 0001" mentions; dblp already assigns them to one person and they start in one dblp-prior cluster) and counts it as SAME_NUMBERED_NAME_PAIRS_SKIPPED. Downstream review sampling must then draw such pairs from the dblp-prior clusters.

property.name: scholarchain.export.policyVersion
property.description: Policy version of the J09 run (dispositions); exported records keep the provenance of the job that produced them.

property.name: scholarchain.export.reducers
property.description: J09 reduce tasks. Year-bearing entities are written under year=YYYY/.
